accordion-trigger.text: How do I reset my password?

accordion-content.text: Click on 'Forgot Password' on the login page, enter your email address, and we'll send you a link to reset your password. The link will expire in 24 hours.

accordion-trigger.text: Can I change my subscription plan?

accordion-content.text: Yes, you can upgrade or downgrade your plan at any time from your account settings. Changes will be reflected in your next billing cycle.

accordion-trigger.text: What payment methods do you accept?

accordion-content.text: We accept all major credit cards, PayPal, and bank transfers. All payments are processed securely through our payment partners.
